name: Mother's Eye
source: Legacy of the First World pg. 17
body:
Mother's Eye (Su)
Source Legacy of the First World pg. 17
The witch can see through plant matter, as the greensight universal monster ability (Pathfinder RPG Bestiary 4 295), for a number of minutes per day equal to her witch level. These minutes do not need to be consecutive, but must be spent in 1-minute increments.
